national.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
national.description: Free, confidential support by call, text, or chat, 24 hours a day, every day. Text and chat are also available in Spanish.

national.name: Hospital social worker
national.description: Healthcare social workers help patients understand a diagnosis and adjust, help people move from the hospital to home, and give information about services and support groups. Ask the care team whether a social worker is available.
national.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Outlook Handbook: Social Workers (bls.gov/ooh/community-and-social-service/social-workers.htm)

national.name: Hospital chaplaincy (spiritual care)
national.description: Professional chaplains give emotional and spiritual care to patients and families, and respect differences in culture and faith practice. Ask the care team whether chaplaincy is available.
national.source: Association of Professional Chaplains, Common Qualifications and Competencies for Professional Chaplains (apchaplains.org)

national.name: Hospital complaint contact
national.description: Each hospital must tell patients whom to contact to file a complaint. Ask the hospital for that contact.

national.name: Free qualified interpreter
national.description: You can ask the hospital for a qualified interpreter at no cost.
